title.zh: Robinhood Q3 Revenue Meets Estimates as Prediction Market Revenue Surges and Cry
title.en: Robinhood Q3 Revenue Meets Estimates as Prediction Market Revenue Surges and Cry

current_state.zh: Robinhood's Q3 2026 revenue of $1.424B met estimates but EPS missed at $0.51, with crypto transaction revenue down 55% to $120M, prediction-market revenue up over sixfold to $173M, and its Robinhood Chain mainnet logging $80B in DEX volume and $50M+ in fees in its first quarter.
